name: MRGG Mid-Range Gas Guns
description: Adds two modular battle rifles: the MRGG-A (Assaulter) and MRGG-S (Sniper). Both are natively chambered in 6.5mm Creedmoor and accept a swappable .308/7.62 NATO conversion barrel. Stats are based on the SCAR-H/SCAR-17 with slightly lower base damage, better accuracy and range, and reduced recoil.
